package_claims_verified: Counts verified by direct inspection of the extracted ZIP's catalog/*.json: 66 screens, 340 panels, 41 forms, 284 fields, 170 actions, 1270 test_cases, 36 journeys, 280 api_contracts. All match the delivery's own stated numbers exactly.
scope_reality: 66 screens across 4 interfaces is far larger than any single session can implement with this build's own standing practice (real tests, load-bearing verification of every safety-critical invariant) in one pass. Building incrementally, screen-by-screen / phase-by-phase, exactly as every other phase in this project has been built -- never claiming a screen is done until it has real DB-backed queries/commands and real passing tests.

fifth_slice.real_bug_found_and_fixed_along_the_way: Adding release_reviews to app/db.py's _TENANT_SCOPED_TABLES broke the EARLIER 04c418cbb547 migration on a fresh `alembic upgrade head` replay -- that migration calls the shared _apply_row_level_security helper with no args, which read the CURRENT (now-grown) tuple including a table that didn't exist yet at that point in migration history. Fixed by giving _apply_row_level_security an explicit `tables` parameter and pinning 04c418cbb547 to its own frozen snapshot of the 6 tables that actually existed then, rather than the live, ever-growing module constant. Caught by actually replaying the full migration chain against a disposable cluster, not by reasoning about it.

tests/test_api_key.py (7 tests) + tests/test_dashboard_routes.py (+4) -- covers the scope allowlist, the expiry requirement, that only a hash (never the raw secret) is ever reloadable, idempotent revoke, and cross-account revoke refusal. sixteenth_slice.name: AD-12 (Business economics and royalties) -- real booked revenue, honestly bounded
sixteenth_slice.why_this_slice: No new model needed -- app/models/billing.py's Subscription already carries real price_cents/currency/state. AD-12's own acceptance text 'investment profits are not revenue' is implemented literally: this module never touches LedgerEntry (Phase 03's trading P&L journal, a completely different Book concept), only real Subscription rows in a genuinely payment-recognized state.
what_was_built: app/services/business_economics.py -- get_business_economics: sums Subscription.price_cents grouped by currency, restricted to ACTIVE_PAID/PAST_DUE/CANCEL_AT_PERIOD_END (a charge genuinely collected or still owed under an already-collected period); PENDING_PAYMENT/TRIAL_AUTHORIZED (never charged) and DISPUTED (contested, not safely booked) are excluded
app/api/dashboard_routes.py + app/templates/ad12_business.html -- GET /ops/business, gated by a new 'view_business_economics' permission (OWNER, BILLING_OPERATOR)

tests/test_business_economics.py (+6, added to the existing 5 pure-function tests) + tests/test_dashboard_routes.py (+3) -- covers the real empty state, correct summing, tenant scoping, per-currency grouping, and that unpaid/disputed subscriptions never count as revenue. The revenue-recognition guard was load-bearing-verified (temporarily widened it to every SubscriptionState, confirmed 3 tests -- 2 unit, 1 HTTP -- failed with unpaid/disputed subscriptions inflating revenue, restored).
sixteenth_slice.near_miss_caught_and_fixed: app/services/business_economics.py and its test file already existed from an earlier phase (CP-071/CP-036's compute_unit_contribution/compute_break_even) -- a first draft of this slice overwrote both files wholesale with Write instead of adding to them, silently deleting that pre-existing, tested functionality. Caught before committing by noticing `git add` reported these as Modified rather than Added, then diffing against HEAD; fixed by restoring the original content in full and adding this slice's own additions on top, never replacing anything. Re-ran the full suite (398 passed, up from 393) and redid the load-bearing verification against the merged file before committing.
sixteenth_slice.deliberately_not_built: Fees/refunds, provider royalties, cost attribution, margin and statement exceptions are all NOT implemented -- no refund/royalty/cost/margin model exists in this build; each is rendered as an explicit UNSUPPORTED, never a fabricated zero or a margin computed from admittedly incomplete inputs. 'Export business report' (F-REPORT) is not built -- no bounded export-job infrastructure exists.

standing_constraints_from_master_prompt: No live orders/cancellations, customer charges/subscriptions, live publication, production resets, credential rotation, or unapproved infrastructure spending.
Isolated synthetic fixtures are authorized only in test/browser databases, never seeded into production.
Reuse existing FastAPI + Jinja2/Chart.js/Tabulator conventions -- no React/Dash rewrite, no second frontend server, no second trading engine.
Private signal-copier (SQLite, owner auth) stays separate from signal-portfolio-commercial (Postgres, tenant auth) -- commercial owner is never private trading authority.
Every action needs real role/tenant/object/state checks derived from the authenticated principal, never a caller-supplied tenant_id.
Missing external credentials/accounts block only external qualification, never the independently buildable UI/service work.
User's own standing instruction (carried from Phase 08): everything stays paper-traded; notify before anything is ready for promotion to live.
